annotations.title: Get the link to the rate request form

description: The link to FreeRateUpdate's short request form for one product. This tool only returns the link and how to use it; it submits nothing. Opening the link and filling in the form with the person's own details, or giving them the link, is how a person asks lenders and brokers in our network to contact them with their own rates and options.
name: get_start_link
title: Get the link to the rate request form
